action.content: Write two limericks for moms about how hard it is to get their kids to do chores. Be angry about it. Separate your two limericks with six asterisks (******).
action.label: context

action.content:
[DRAFT]
My kid's room is a total mess,
A chaotic and filthy distress.
I scream, "Clean it up!"
But he just gives a shrug,
And leaves all the trash in a mess.

******

I beg, I plead, I shout, I rage,
To make them pick up their garbage.
They stare at the floor,
And ignore me once more,
While I'm stuck in this angry garbage.
